title: Mariachi balcony bar
summary: Expanded the west casino wing with stairs and a bar balcony above the mariachi stage.
notes: A four-metre-wide staircase reaches the five-metre balcony, with walnut and brass guards.
New GridMap stair and sloped railing pieces are available alongside the existing wall and floor kit.
The furnished balcony is listed in GPS as Mariachi Balcony Bar.
